sql_templates.description: Selects symbols with insider alerts and strong buying signals in the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_bulks AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(deal_date) AS latest_date
  FROM signals.bulk_block_deals
  GROUP BY symbol
),
insider_signals AS (
  SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, ia.entity, ia.qty, ia.value_cr, ia.insider_score
  FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
  JOIN latest_bulks lb ON ia.symbol = lb.symbol
  WHERE ia.alert_date = lb.latest_date
),
combined AS (
  SELECT bbd.symbol, bbd.entity, bbd.side, bbd.qty, bbd.price, bbd.deal_type, ss.stage,
         ss.technical_score, ss.trading_signal
  FROM signals.bulk_block_deals bbd
  JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON bbd.symbol = ss.symbol
  WHERE bbd.deal_date = (SELECT MAX(deal_date) FROM signals.bulk_block_deals)
  AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT symbol, entity, side, qty, price, deal_type, stage, technical_score, trading_signal
FROM combined
WHERE trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
LIMIT 50;
